prompt: Spring SimpleJdbcCall stored function metadata lookup supported databases
answer:
Spring `SimpleJdbcCall` supports stored function metadata lookup for:

- MySQL
- Microsoft SQL Server
- Oracle
- PostgreSQL

For other databases, declare the function parameters explicitly.  
Source: [Spring Integration — Stored Procedures](https://docs.spring.io/spring-integration/reference/jdbc/stored-procedures.html)
